title: Lost in Vyond
overview: Cesar Rosas Jr. knows that making animation is hard, and using specific websites may limit your imagination on how you want to make animation. Once he discovered Vyond, he was thrilled. Once his computer uses hypnosis and knocks Cesar out, he wakes up in a 2-D universe. Cesar is inside the Vyond world. Tom Doe tries to help Cesar return to his home universe by using the untested theme portal. but after Cesar destroyed the portal, the Virus-Bot was summoned, and Cesar is now wanted by the Vyond community, who wishes to sacrifice Cesar's life to the Virus-Bot so it would spare their world. Cesar can't return home as a criminal, first he must make up for his mistake and save Vyond.
